```artifact
Feature: System Access and User Management

  Scenario: System availability on specified pin codes
  Given the system is configured with specified pin codes in the Parameter Control File
  When a user attempts to access the system from a non-specified pin code
  Then the system should deny access

  Scenario Outline: System access for different pin codes
  Given the system is configured with specified pin codes in the Parameter Control File
  When a user attempts to access the system from <pin_code>
  Then the system should <access_result>

  Examples:
    | pin_code | access_result |
    | 1234     | deny access    |
    | 5678     | allow access   |

Feature: User Login and Password Management

  Scenario: User login with valid credentials
  Given a user has valid login credentials
  When the user attempts to log in
  Then the system should grant access

  Scenario Outline: User login with different credentials
  Given a user has <credentials>
  When the user attempts to log in
  Then the system should <login_result>

  Examples:
    | credentials | login_result |
    | valid       | grant access   |
    | invalid     | deny access    |

Feature: Doctor and Speciality Linkage

  Scenario: Doctor linked to a speciality
  Given a doctor is linked to a speciality
  When the doctor attempts to access the speciality
  Then the system should grant access

  Scenario Outline: Doctor access to multiple specialities
  Given a doctor is linked to <specialities>
  When the doctor attempts to access the specialities
  Then the system should <access_result>

  Examples:
    | specialities | access_result |
    | single       | grant access   |
    | multiple    | deny access    |

Feature: Patient and Doctor Linkage

  Scenario: Patient linked to a doctor
  Given a patient is linked to a doctor
  When the patient attempts to access the doctor
  Then the system should grant access

  Scenario Outline: Patient access to multiple doctors
  Given a patient is linked to <doctors>
  When the patient attempts to access the doctors
  Then the system should <access_result>

  Examples:
    | doctors | access_result |
    | single   | grant access   |
    | multiple | deny access    |

Feature: Patient Registration and Consultation Requests

  Scenario: Patient registration with unique id
  Given a patient registers with a unique id
  When the patient attempts to register
  Then the system should grant access

  Scenario Outline: Patient registration with different ids
  Given a patient registers with <id>
  When the patient attempts to register
  Then the system should <registration_result>

  Examples:
    | id | registration_result |
    | unique | grant access   |
    | duplicate | deny access    |

  Scenario: Patient consultation request
  Given a patient requests a consultation
  When the patient attempts to request
  Then the system should grant access

  Scenario Outline: Patient consultation request with different ids
  Given a patient requests <id>
  When the patient attempts to request
  Then the system should <request_result>

  Examples:
    | id | request_result |
    | unique | grant access   |
    | duplicate | deny access    |
```
